text:
ana: quick thread  we have a patch-only backport for 1.9.x (auth token validation). decision: tag 1.9.6 or create a special hotfix tag?

josh: keep semver clean  1.9.6 patch bump. avoid suffixes in tag names.

claire: agree. but we should mark the release metadata as security so deploys are gated. last time auto-rollforward hit clients.

ben: deploy-bot can require human_ack if release.meta contains 'security-backport'. we should also include a short ops checklist in the release body.

ops-bot: scan result: patch-only backport detected; impacted: auth-service; auto_deploy: false. suggested timeline: manual deploy during change window 02:00-03:00 UTC.

ana: small correction: tag will be 1.9.6, release body includes: CVE id (if assigned), ops checklist, and meta: [security-backport, manual_ack].

josh: do NOT auto-pin stable customers. notify account teams and recommend upgrade.

claire: add a note in changelog generator: append "(security backport; manual deploy)" when meta flag present.

ben: acknowledged. deploy-bot will block until two human acks are recorded. please @mention on PR.

ana: thanks all. i'll open PR with template and ping #release-channel. close after post-deploy checks pass.
